summary: CI run 2 fixes: an unclosed sqlite connection in one test, a too-strict gc.collect assertion, and the packaged smoke script updated for the beta learning-map setting and the PDF-source eligibility gate (a stale script, reproduced on macOS), with Windows-only tolerant cleanup.
scope_note: Third commit on worktree windows-release (after 5d3955e and coordinator b962084). files lists this commit's paths.

budget_impact.rationale: Packaging, file locking and paths only; no model call, prompt, retry, network call or data leaving the machine. CI builds use no secrets.
budget_impact.after: macOS and Windows x64 builds; same zero-token core

additional_checks.scope: smoke script end to end against the source backend on macOS; not a packaged binary

open_risks: The frozen Windows exe has not run the smoke script; later steps may expose Windows-only differences.
The smoke script was stale relative to main; other scripts not run by CI may be too.
